title: Google AdWords for salons: how to make $3,600 in bookings with $175 in ads

facts.fact: The author cites Main Street ROI as the source for the claim that 71% of ads on the internet are done through Google.
facts.quote: 71% of the ads on the internet are done through Google

facts.fact: The author cites Main Street ROI as the source for the claim that businesses make $2 for every $1 they spend on AdWords.
facts.quote: On average, businesses make $2 for every $1 they spend on AdWords

facts.fact: The author cites Main Street ROI as the source for the claim that 72% of potential clients prefer to find information about local businesses via search.
facts.quote: 72% of your potential clients prefer to find information about local businesses like yours via search

facts.fact: The page states that 98% of searchers choose a business that is on page 1 of the search results they get.
facts.quote: 98% of those searchers choose a business that is on page 1 of the results they get.

facts.fact: Per the page, Mozaik Skin & Body's revenue grew from $5,800 per month to $70,000 per month within a few years after its owner bought the day spa.
facts.quote: took it from$5,800/mo to $70,000/mo in just a few years

facts.fact: In the Mozaik couples massage Google Ads campaign, the ad received 92 clicks.
facts.quote: Clicks on the ad from Google:** 92

facts.fact: In the Mozaik couples massage Google Ads campaign, total ad cost was $175.
facts.quote: Total cost:** $175

facts.fact: In the Mozaik couples massage Google Ads campaign, 31 people booked an appointment, a 34% conversion rate.
facts.quote: Total conversions** (how many people booked an appointment): 31 (34%)

facts.fact: In the Mozaik couples massage Google Ads campaign, the page reports $3,689 in revenue from 31 people who spent $119 each.
facts.quote: Revenue Generated:** $3,689 (31 people who spent $119 each)

facts.fact: The page states that each new booking in the Mozaik campaign cost $5.60 and had a value of $119.
facts.quote: Each new booking cost him just $5.60, with a value of $119.

facts.fact: The page's headline and section heading describe generating $3,600 in bookings or revenue with under $200 in ad spend.
facts.quote: How to generate $3,600 in revenue through for your salon, spending less than $200

facts.fact: The article was published on 2017-08-04.
The page advises using regular Google AdWords rather than AdWords Express when setting up an account.
facts.quote: make sure you’re using regular AdWords and not Adwords Express

facts.fact: The page advises starting with a small ad budget and adjusting it based on the number of clicks received or desired.
facts.quote: Start small and adjust according to how many clicks you’re getting or want to get.

facts.fact: The author suggests that a daily budget of $5-10 should be enough to get several clicks a day on Google Ads.
facts.quote: Even $5-10 a day should be enough to get several clicks a day.

facts.fact: Google Ads charges per click, so advertisers are not charged unless someone clicks the ad.
facts.quote: Don’t forget that you’re not charged unless you get a click.

facts.fact: The cost per click varies by the advertiser's location, the targeted keyword, and how well the ad is written, and big cities are more competitive and therefore more expensive.
facts.quote: You’re charged an amount for every click which varies depending on where you’re located (big cities are more competitive therefore more expensive)

facts.fact: Google recommends using 15-20 keywords in an ad campaign.
facts.quote: Google recommends 15-20 keywords, so try different mixes of words

facts.fact: A Google search text ad consists of two headlines and a body, with 120 characters of text total.
facts.quote: Two headlines and a body and only 120 characters of text total!

facts.fact: The author advises unselecting the Display network so that the ad appears only on Google Search.
facts.quote: Unselect “Display network” so that your ad only appears on Google Search.

facts.fact: The author states that if a salon gets 100 visitors and no bookings, there is probably a problem with the landing page.
facts.quote: If you have 100 visitors and no bookings, there is a probably a problem with your landing page.

facts.fact: The author advises that the ad body should have every letter of every word capitalized.
facts.quote: The body should have each letter of every word capitalized
